explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/882: what is the largest A ⊆ [1,n] whose nonempty subset sums are pairwise non-dividing? ELRSS99 gives |A| > log₂n - 1 and Problem 1 gives |A| ≤ log₂n + ½log₂log n + O(1), so the maximum is (1+o(1))log₂n. IsSubsetSumAntichain forbids divisibility between sums of distinct nonempty subsets. For positive elements this is equivalent to the page's condition on the set of sums (equal sums would give t and 2t). The statement asserts maxAntichainCard n / log₂ n → 1. Faithful.
